fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responders can identify it quickly when approaching under low visibility or nighttime conditions.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass through without branches blocking mirrors, windows, or roof-mounted equipment.
• Clear a flat, firm area near the main residence that is large enough for an emergency vehicle to turn around without backing onto the road.
• Cut back dense vegetation to create open walking paths between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move quickly between the two buildings.
• Trim shrubs and low tree branches that overhang or press against the walls or roofline of the detached structure.
• Trim shrubs and low tree branches that overhang or press against the walls or roofline of the main residence.
• Keep a gate or pathway on at least one side of the property unlocked and wide enough for responders on foot to reach the rear of the structures without passing through dense vegetation.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from the large trees that hang directly over or within a few feet of the structure.
• Thin the dense tree clusters to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove dead branches and accumulated leaf litter from beneath the tree clusters.
• Clear dry leaves, needles, and plant debris that have collected against the base of the structure.
• Keep the area directly around the structure free of shrubs and low-growing plants that connect to nearby trees.
• Trim low branches on the scattered trees so flames cannot easily climb from the ground into the upper canopy.
• Rake and remove dead needles and leaves that have built up beneath the large trees near the structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
